'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 2 Steven Lewis LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Just Hopin' This Isn't Expected From Me
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
